gloss: sacred precinct; holy ground; divine realm

definitions.explanation: The grounds of a shrine or temple that are considered sacred and sanctified.
A figurative use describing a level of skill, achievement, or quality so extraordinary that it seems beyond human ability.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神域|しんいき}だ。
examples.english: From here on is sacred ground.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鳥居|とりい}→鳥居：05956_torii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧くぐる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{神域|しんいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: When you pass through the torii gate, you enter the sacred precinct.

examples.japanese: {伊勢神宮|いせじんぐう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{神域|しんいき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{広大|こうだい}→広大：11328_koudai⟧な⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{囲|かこ}まれ→囲む：02037_kakomu⟧、⟦{厳|おごそ}か→厳か：11864_ogosoka⟧な⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漂|ただよ}っている→漂う：04356_tadayou⟧。
examples.english: The sacred precinct of Ise Grand Shrine is surrounded by vast forests, with a solemn atmosphere in the air.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神域|しんいき}だ。
examples.english: That athlete's skill is on a godlike level.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{神域|しんいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}している→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: His piano playing has reached a divine level.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経|へ}て→経る：13876_heru⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技|わざ}→技：02172_waza⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧もはや{神域|しんいき}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ぶ→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ふさわしいもの⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After years of training, that craftsman's skill has become worthy of being called divine.

notes:
A compound of {神|しん} (god, deity) and {域|いき} (area, realm). In its original sense, it refers to the physical sacred grounds of a Shinto shrine, marked by ⟦{鳥居|とりい}→鳥居：05956_torii⟧ (torii gates) or ⟦{注連縄|しめなわ}→注連縄：06015_shimenawa⟧ (sacred ropes).

The figurative sense has become very popular, especially in sports, entertainment, and internet culture, to describe something of superhuman quality. It is often used with ⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧ (to reach) or on its own as a predicate.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {神域|しんいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter sacred ground
- {神域|しんいき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧: to reach a godlike level
- {神域|しんいき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧: forest of the sacred precinct
- {神域|しんいき}⟦レベル→レベル：00352_reberu⟧: godlike level (casual/internet)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{境内|けいだい}→境内：12095_keidai⟧: temple/shrine grounds — the physical area within a religious compound
- ⟦{聖地|せいち}→聖地：18255_seichi⟧: holy land, sacred place — broader term for any place considered holy
- ⟦{神|かみ}→神：02147_kami⟧: god — the figurative slang use ("godly") for something extraordinary
